title: Balancing Fairness and Accuracy in Sentiment Detection using Multiple Black Box Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its primary focus is on measuring and mitigating gender bias in sentiment detection APIs in the context of crime news headlines.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion. Its focus is on measuring and mitigating gender bias in sentiment detection models.
